$comment: Rules the target release's own metadata cannot place in or out of scope. Domains and example languages classify almost every rule on their own, so an entry here records a decision that could not be derived — never a convenience, and never a way to silence a rule the metadata does classify. Each entry carries a direction: "in" means the rule is in scope and belongs in the presets, "out" means it is out of scope and must not be listed.

noRestrictedTypes.reason: A TypeScript rule, correctly listed. Its only fenced block is its own options sample, so it publishes no code example to read a language from, and it declares no domain — neither signal can place it. Listed under the noRestricted* convention at a bare severity with no options.
